reader_summary.headline: We kick off Crypto for Institutions 2 with Marcos Veremis.
reader_summary.overview: We kick off Crypto for Institutions 2 with Marcos Veremis. Marcos is a Partner at Accolade Partners, a $4.4 billion venture fund of funds whose founder Joelle Kayden appeared on the show earlier this year. Marcos manages $1 billion in blockchain fund of fund assets across liquid and venture strategies.

key_points.text: He is one of the most well-regarded allocators in the space.
Our conversation covers Marcos' discovery of crypto while at Cambridge, building a formal research practice, and following institutional interest in the space.
We then turn to his transition from consultant to the buy side (of the buy side) and his approach to manager selection, due diligence.
